# porkbun_email_forwards (Data Source)

Retrieve all email forwards associated with a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porkbun_email_forwards" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name.

### Read-Only

- `dns_configured` (Boolean) Whether the domain's DNS is configured for email forwarding.
- `email_forwards` (Attributes Set) List of email forwards. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_forwards))
- `limits` (Attributes) The forwards the domain has (`used`, including any Porkbun manages itself) and may have (`max`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))

<a id="nestedatt--email_forwards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_forwards`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The forwarded address: the part before the `@`.
- `created` (String) When the forward was created.
- `forward_to` (String) The mailbox mail is delivered to.


<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) The maximum number of forwards allowed.
- `used` (Number) The number of forwards in use.
